Atlantic Trust Group Llc sold 11,352 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.91% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 382 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $57,000, down from 11,734 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atlantic Trust Group Llc who had been investing in Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.05 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.11% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $157.15. About 238,741 shares traded. Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (NASDAQ:VRTX) has risen 76.59% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 65.04% the S&P500.
